cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
cards.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I stood when you stood, ready for our encore. They'll remember this audition when I win.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stood because the piano pedal snapped. We haven't even finished your song.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, a dramatic pause. The recovery will be the part the judges remember.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll have to finish without piano. I can give you the starting note.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give it to me. When I win with no accompaniment, make sure they know I started with a broken piano.

reason: Replace the unsupported Stance overlay with a concrete mistaken imitation whose correction redirects A's exact Drive pursuit; distinguish the alternative's relationship and immediate pressure.
